repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-team
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.team for Webex teams on the conversation service. create() resolves participants to uuids (creator first), builds a conversation-shaped payload with objectType 'team', and POSTs it to the conversation service resource teams; get(), list() (including the additionalUrls hosts), and listConversations() read teams and their conversations and record member uuids; createConversation() and joinConversation() create and join team conversations, granting the general conversation's KMS resource access to new ones. Membership, moderator, conversation, archive, and field changes are activities posted to the team's general conversation through webex.internal.conversation. Importing the package also registers payload transforms that encrypt a team's displayName and summary with a new KMS key, decrypt them and the team's conversations on the way in, normalize its lists, and decrypt teamRoomStatus events. It stores nothing itself.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-team package entry
public_interfaces.audience: first-party Webex clients and the SDK packages that register it
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports the conversation, user, and encryption plugins, then registers Team as internal plugin 'team' with config {team: {}} and payload transforms that encrypt and decrypt team displayName and summary, normalize team lists, and decrypt teamRoomStatus events; the first registration of the name wins. The default export is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.team methods
public_interfaces.notes: create, get, list, listConversations, createConversation, and joinConversation request the conversation service directly; every other method posts an activity to the team's general conversation through webex.internal.conversation. create and createConversation write the resolved participant uuids back to params.participants. Argument guards reject before any request; a team object without conversations makes the activity methods throw synchronously.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not encrypt or decrypt team fields inside Team methods.
negative_guidance.why: The transforms in src/index.js own that and run through the conversation plugin's dispatch.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not post team activities to the team URL.
negative_guidance.why: Team activities are posted to the general conversation (INV-001).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not rename decryptTeam, encryptTeam, or normalizeTeam.
negative_guidance.why: The conversation plugin reaches them by name from objectType 'team'.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not drop the general conversation KRO from a team conversation's KMS message.
negative_guidance.why: Team members decrypt open room titles through it (INV-003).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log team names, summaries, member records, or tokens.
negative_guidance.why: They are user data; the only existing log line carries an error object.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as a usage reference.
negative_guidance.why: Its Usage block names a placeholder member; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage script or threshold exists.
